user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.scope: Web content used for training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited upon user request in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply because actions are user-initiated

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Gathers public web data to enhance model utility and safety.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve content at Claude users' direction.
user_agents.scope: Fetches web content in response to individual user queries in Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes web content to improve search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Indexes and analyzes online content to improve relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and general search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under user-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images, logos, and favicons for Google Search and Images.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl video content for video-related Google Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Power Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools in Search Console; does not affect Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible content for internal research, development, and product teams.
user_agents.scope: Generic non-product specific crawls and internal research.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for generic research and development.
user_agents.scope: Generic image crawls not tied to specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for generic research and development.
user_agents.scope: Generic video crawls not tied to specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agent builds; does not affect Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manage content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules in robots.txt under Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet automatically or on user requests.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Collects data and fetches web content in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler powering search across Spotlight, Siri, and Safari
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering across the web
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Apple foundation models for generative AI features
user_agents.scope: Data usage determination for content crawled by Applebot
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps such as Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Content of an app or website shared on Meta apps via copy-paste or social plugins.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content to enhance Meta AI relevance, accuracy, citations, and linking.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Meta-WebIndexer in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising and business use cases.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Meta-ExternalAds in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web for training foundation AI models or improving products.
user_agents.scope: Web content indexed directly for foundation AI model training and product improvements.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Meta-ExternalAgent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to help AI navigate websites and complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules as it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: General web crawler for Bing search indexing and AI features.
user_agents.scope: Indexes content across the web for Microsoft Bing services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Bingbot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Fetches page previews and content for Microsoft services.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves real-time previews and content for user requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow MicrosoftPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Amazon products and services, customer information, and AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use noarchive/noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Search experiences; does not crawl content for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use page-level meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live information from the web to support user actions.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions and live queries; does not crawl for AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to build open datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of web pages sampled across the Internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
